prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Factorio game sprite atlas, genuinely transparent PNG. Create ONE clean compact industrial three-way personnel-routing sign design, shown as FOUR cardinal directional variants in a strict 2x2 atlas: TOP LEFT points NORTH/up, TOP RIGHT points EAST/right, BOTTOM LEFT points SOUTH/down, BOTTOM RIGHT points WEST/left. Transparent background alpha=0, no ground plane, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no checkerboard, no extra props. Each quadrant contains precisely one complete isolated sprite with generous empty transparent margins, equal scale, consistent lighting and exactly the same mechanical construction. Factorio camera: orthographic bird's-eye three-quarter game view, north always screen up, richly painted realistic rusty metal game sprite, warm worn bronze fittings and restrained dark teal-blue enamel panels with cream-white directional arrows. IMPORTANT: one low-profile single pedestal / squat mechanical junction housing per variant, absolutely no tall signposts and no multiple poles. Design a compact flat T-shaped sign/hub: three short armored arrow arms radiate from one circular central hub toward the three exits. The central straight arm is slightly stronger and has a clearly visible cream arrow; two matching smaller side arms also carry clear cream arrows. For north variant exits are up, left, right (open bottom/incoming); east variant exits right, up, down (open left/incoming); south variant exits down, right, left (open top/incoming); west variant exits left, down, up (open right/incoming). At the tip of EACH of the THREE exit arms put one clearly recognizable small brass electrical cable socket, with paired red and green metal contacts; all three sockets must be equally obvious and visibly distinct, this is a circuit junction game entity. The entire apparatus fits inside a two-tile square and should not tower over walking biters. Keep silhouettes bold and arrow marks legible at 64 pixel in-game size. Restrained mechanical detailing, rivets, slight wear, avoid visual clutter. Lighting from upper-left; only tight contact shading integral to the object, no external drop shadow. Render as transparent game sprite atlas with true alpha.
